title: Engine Oil Pressure SW Error
detail_of_failure: An error occurs in the signal circuit of the engine oil pressure switch.
machine_effect: • The protection function by the engine oil pressure does not operate. • The engine oil pressure monitor is not shown correctly.
related_information: k For the check and replacement work of the engine oil pressure switch, open the engine oil filler port. Check that the engine oil temperature is decreased sufficiently to not get burned. • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Turn the starting switch to the ON position or start the engine. • The engine oil pressure switch closes (ON) when the oil pressure is low (engine stopped), and opens (OFF) when the oil pressure is high (engine in operation). • For this failure code, the engine controller checks if the oil pressure switch is closed (ON), that is, at “GND level”, only when the engine is stopped. • Error of the engine oil pressure switch during engine operation is checked for failure code [B@BAZG].

steps.procedure: Check the wiring harness and connector. For details, see “Related Information to Troubleshooting”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”.
1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector OIL PRESSURE SWITCH, and connect a T- adapter to the male side.

measurements.point: Between OIL PRESSURE SWITCH (male) (1) and ground

steps.cause: Open or short circuit in wiring harness
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector ECM. Connect a T-adapter to the female side.
If no failure is found by the previous checks, the engine controller is defective. (Because this is an internal defect, troubleshooting cannot be done.)
